title: CEOs Are Lying About AI Layoffs - Here's What That Actually Means
metaDescription: While CEOs fumble their AI messaging, people who see what's really happening are building skills that make them untouchable.
author: Marty @ CertFlo

sections.heading: CEOs Are Getting Coached on How to Lie Better
sections.body: Business Insider just caught something interesting. CEOs are literally getting coached on how to talk about layoffs without saying the quiet part out loud. PR experts are telling them to stop using phrases like 'lower-value human capital' and - this is the big one - to stop blaming AI for workforce decisions. The timing of this Business Insider report tells you everything. Corporate America is in full damage control mode while the AI transformation is happening behind closed doors anyway. They're moving fast on automation but they suck at talking about it. That gap? That's where you come in.
